Contrary to popular belief cell phone use isn't prohibited because of the plane electronics. It's to protect the infrastructure of the phone network on the ground. That's why use in aircraft mode is allowed, because the phone is not transmitting.

The problem for the infrastructure is that you have up to 500 people and therefore about as many phones travelling at a high speed between the towers in each plane. So there has to be a tower to tower handover every few seconds, what is very demanding for the infrastructure.

That's why the FAA doesn't care about cell phones on planes, the FCC does.
